shellCommands.command: for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx lib/data.ts "app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx" __agent_eval__/run.mjs tsconfig.json; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done
find .next/server/app/projects/acme.segments -type f | sed 's|^|FILE |' ; echo "=== sizes ==="; find .next/server/app/projects/acme.segments -type f -exec ls -l {} \; | awk '{print $5, $9}'

cd .next/server/app/projects/acme.segments && echo "### PAGE segment ###" && tr -d '\0' < 'projects/$d$slug/__PAGE__.segment.rsc' | grep -o -E 'Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront|Production deployment|Loading project' | sort | uniq -c
cd /workspace && rm -rf .next && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -18

for f in .next/server/app/projects/acme.segments/projects/'$d$slug'/__PAGE__.segment.rsc .next/server/app/projects/acme.html; do echo "### $f"; ls -l "$f" | awk '{print "size:", $5}'; tr -d '\0' < "$f" | grep -o -E 'Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront|Production deployment|Loading project' | sort | uniq -c; done

(npx next start -p 3123 >/tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; echo "--- first request (cold cache) ---"; time curl -s localhost:3123/projects/acme | grep -o -E 'Acme Storefront|Commerce storefront and checkout|Production deployment|Loading project' | sort | uniq -c; echo "--- second request (warm cache) ---"; time curl -s localhost:3123/projects/acme >/dev/null; echo "--- unknown slug ---"; curl -s localhost:3123/projects/nope | grep -o -E 'Unknown project|could not be found' | sort | uniq -c
pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server" ; sleep 1; echo done; cd /workspace && git diff --stat
